Ukraine and Russia trade Black Sea attacks amid grain export concerns

Ukraine has conducted drone strikes targeting Russian naval facilities, including a base in Novorossiysk and a refinery 800 miles from the border. Russia, in turn, has attacked Ukrainian ports on the Danube River. Ukraine has reportedly offered Russia a truce in the Black Sea to halt attacks on civilian ships and reopen a crucial grain corridor. These escalating attacks have raised concerns about global food prices and the security of grain exports. Ukraine has also accused Russia of holding illegal elections in occupied territories.
